text:
Alex Ramos: Heads-up — Accelerator Labs (enterprise) wants a bespoke onramp for a 6mo POC. They asked for dedicated pool + private deployment. Request: 25% off list pricing and $0 onboarding for the POC. They’ll sign a short MSA but security wants extra IP/data clauses. Need deal-desk approval and any staging/ops notes.

Priya Shah: Re: dedicated + private — small cluster (2x A100 equiv) should cover their concurrency based on our perf numbers. We can scope a scaled-down config to control cost. Sec questionnaire flagged E3 (data retention) and KMS.

Jordan Lee: 25% across the board for committed spend seems steep for a short 6mo trial. What’s the expected committed $ amount? margin math below: 
```
Estimated usage (tokens/month): 1.2B
List cost estimate: $36k/mo
6mo list revenue: $216k
25% discount impact: -$54k
Net: $162k (before infra credits)
```
We need approval from finance for >20% on short-term pilots.

Alex Ramos: They’re offering a $120k committed payment up front for 6 months if we include the 25% and onboarding. That’s what they said is in their procurement timeline. They want private deploy in our GCP region eu-west1.

Eliot Morris (deal-desk): Thanks Alex. Quick read: we can’t blanket 25% on a 6mo without Exec signoff. Two pragmatic options that typically pass: 1) 15% off list + $15k onboarding credit, or 2) 20% off list with a 12mo convertible clause (if they convert to annual, we honor the 20%). Also need the security exceptions documented.

Casey Ng: Contract note — customer wants a custom IP/data clause: "supplier retains model weights, customer retains prompt+data". Legal flagged this as nonstandard but workable if we add an explicit data retention period and audit rights.

Priya Shah: Operational note — if we give 15% + onboarding credit we can provision a smaller private cluster and enable KV caching to get latency under 200ms. That reduces our infra burn.

Jordan Lee: If they pay $120k upfront and we offer 15% + $15k credit, net revenue = $120k - $15k = $105k, still within acceptable margin after infra costs. Recommend approving 15% and onboarding credit.

Eliot Morris (deal-desk): I'm +1 for option (15% + $15k credit). I'll need the following to mark as approved: 1) written confirmation of $120k upfront, 2) security exceptions documented and signed off by SecOps, 3) Legal to sign the minor IP/data amendment. If all three are green I can route to Finance for final stamp.

Alex Ramos: I'll get procurement to confirm the $120k wire today. @sec-bot can you summarize outstanding security checklist items for this thread?

sec-bot: Outstanding items detected: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration details, data retention period, network isolation diagram, MFA for admin accounts. Current status: SOC2 uploaded (waiting review), KMS design doc pending, network diagram attached from infra team, retention policy needs temp exception.

Eliot Morris (deal-desk): Perfect. Once SOC2 review passes and SecOps signs the retention exception, I can sign off internally. Please add the exact language for the onboarding credit to the SOW: "$15,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to invoice upon provision."

Casey Ng: Legal will prepare the IP/data amendment with a 90-day retention window and audit rights. Will post draft by EOD.

Alex Ramos: Great — I'm going to push procurement for wire confirmation and will update this thread. If we get the $120k wire plus SecOps + Legal drafts, we accept the 15% + $15k credit counteroffer. Please hold exec escalation unless anything changes. :thumbsup:

Eliot Morris (deal-desk): Noted. If anything stalls, I'll escalate to Sarah (Head of Revenue Ops). Otherwise I’ll route final approval to Finance after you drop the docs.

Priya Shah: For planning: ops will start a soft-provision (non-prod) cluster once we have the wire confirmation so we can run smoke tests and KV warmup. No customer keys until KMS design doc is signed.

Alex Ramos: Thanks all — will update here.

(End of thread)
